info.title: ae/updates
info.description: Store update checks for browser, Apple and Android clients. Methods tagged typescript are exported functions of server/store.ts and web/update.ts; swift and kotlin name the native functions isNewer(_:than:) in apple/Sources/Version.swift and ae.update.isNewer in Kotlin, which compare the same way. Version comparison: numeric components compare with absent components as zero, suffixes after - are discarded, malformed components count as zero, and a current version starting with 0.0.0 never updates. Empty or separator-only version strings are outside the native input contract.

methods.name: updateUrlFor
methods.description: The store's update address for an invitation link http(s)://<host>/l/<one opaque segment>, keeping the whole segment; query and fragment are dropped. Additional path segments, encoded separators or control characters, credentials, whitespace, backslashes and malformed addresses give null.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: null when enabled is false, else updateUrlFor(inviteAddress).

methods.name: isNewer
methods.description: True when latest is a higher version than current.

schema.description: Application version: dot-separated numbers, optionally followed by - and a suffix that does not affect ordering.

methods.name: fetchUpdate
methods.description: Fetches the update address with accept: application/json through the injected fetch and returns version and url when both are strings; null on network failure, unsuccessful status, invalid JSON or another shape. Adds no retries or timeout.

schema.description: Function typeof fetch, the standard Fetch API function.

methods.name: currentVersion
methods.description: The application's CFBundleShortVersionString, or 0.0.0 when absent (a Swift global constant).

enabled.description: false switches updates off; defaults to true.

inviteAddress.description: The store invitation link, for example https://ourapps.app/l/0123456789abcdef01234567.

url.description: Where the update is installed from.

Update.description: The store's answer to GET on the update address (application/json); other fields are dropped.
